major_inclusion_criteria: Age 40-79 years, type 2 diabetes mellitus with HbA1c ≥7.5%, cardiovascular disease (overt, subclinical or at-risk depending on age)
intervention_and_comparator: Glucose lowering therapy with intensive vs standard target (HbA1c <6 vs 7-7.9%), plus two-by-two factorial design for blood pressure treatment (SBP <120 vs <140 mmHg) and lipid-lowering therapy (fenofibrate vs placebo, both with simvastatin)
primary_outcome_follow_up: Composite of nonfatal myocardial infarction, nonfatal stroke, or death from cardiovascular causes (3.5 years)
brain_mri_data: Recruitment and 40-month visits in the ACCORD MIND substudy, plus observational extension at 80 months (ACCORDION MIND study)
genetic_and_brain_mri_data_n: 614 with brain MRI, most with genotyping

major_inclusion_criteria: Age ≥70 years (≥65 years for Black and Hispanic participants in the US), without cardiovascular disease, dementia or disability
intervention_and_comparator: Aspirin 100 mg per day vs placebo
primary_outcome_follow_up: Composite of death, dementia or persistent physical disability (median = 4.7 years)
brain_mri_data: Recruitment, 1- and 3-year visits in the ASPREE-NEURO substudy (3T)
genetic_and_brain_mri_data_n: 559 with brain MRI, most with DNA collected (as part of the ASPREE Healthy Ageing biobank)

major_inclusion_criteria: Age ≥18 years, stable coronary and/or peripheral artery disease
intervention_and_comparator: Three-by-two factorial design for antithrombotic therapy (rivaroxaban 2.5 mg twice daily plus aspirin 100 mg once daily vs rivaroxaban 5 mg twice daily vs aspirin 100 mg once daily) and gastric protection (pantoprazole 40 mg once daily vs placebo)
primary_outcome_follow_up: Composite of cardiovascular death, stroke, or myocardial infarction (23 months)
brain_mri_data: Recruitment and follow-up visits (mean interval = 2 years) in the COMPASS MRI substudy (mostly 1.5T)

major_inclusion_criteria: Age 50-85 years, mild cognitive impairment due to AD or mild AD dementia, amyloid pathology on PET
intervention_and_comparator: Low-dose aducanumab vs high-dose aducanumab vs placebo (randomised 1:1:1)
primary_outcome_follow_up: Change in Clinical Dementia Rating Sum of Boxes (at week 78)
brain_mri_data: Recruitment and at weeks 14, 22, 30, 42, 54, 66, and 78 (1.5T or 3T)
genetic_and_brain_mri_data_n: 1,691 (after quality control, with at least one post-baseline MRI)

major_inclusion_criteria: Age 60-77 years, at increased risk for dementia
intervention_and_comparator: Multidomain intervention (including vascular risk monitoring) vs general health advice

major_inclusion_criteria: Age 60-88 years, cognitive complaint and hypertension plus moderate to severe white matter disease
intervention_and_comparator: Enhanced blood pressure treatment (SBP <135 mmHg vs routine target)
primary_outcome_follow_up: White matter hyperintensity volume progression (3 years)
brain_mri_data: Recruitment and final visits (1.5T or more)

major_inclusion_criteria: Age ≥70 years, without dementia, with either memory complaint, limitations in one instrumental activity of daily living or slow gait speed
intervention_and_comparator: 4 parallel groups: multidomain intervention plus omega 3, multidomain intervention plus placebo, omega 3 alone or placebo alone
primary_outcome_follow_up: Change in cognition as measured by a composite z-score from 4 standardised tests (at the 3-year visit)
genetic_and_brain_mri_data_n: 503 with baseline MRI, most with DNA collected (as part of the MRI-MAPT study)

major_inclusion_criteria: Age ≥18 years with spontaneous intracerebral haemorrhage, atrial fibrillation and indication for anticoagulation
intervention_and_comparator: Anticoagulation with a direct oral anticoagulant vs no anticoagulation
primary_outcome_follow_up: Co-primary outcomes: first ischaemic stroke and first recurrent intracerebral haemorrhage (median = 1.4 years)
brain_mri_data: Baseline and 12-month visit in the Longitudinal Neuroimaging substudy (n=200 with 1.5T or 3T). In all participants, baseline brain scan (MRI if available) plus additional follow-up MRI (if available, as per treating physician).
genetic_and_brain_mri_data_n: Most with brain MRI and genotyping (as part of the Predictive Modelling of Risk substudy)

major_inclusion_criteria: Age ≥50 years with SBP 130-180 mmHg, with increased cardiovascular risk but without diabetes mellitus or prior stroke
intervention_and_comparator: Intensive SBP target (<120 mmHg) vs standard treatment (<140 mmHg)
primary_outcome_follow_up: Composite endpoint: myocardial infarction, other acute coronary syndromes, stroke, heart failure, or death from cardiovascular causes (median = 3.3 years)
brain_mri_data: Baseline and 4-year visits (3T) in SPRINT MIND
genetic_and_brain_mri_data_n: 449 (baseline and follow-up MRI), DNA collected (ancestry informative genetic markers available)

intervention_and_comparator: Two-by-two factorial design for blood pressure treatment (SBP <130 vs 130-149 mmHg) and antiplatelet therapy (clopidogrel 75 mg once daily vs placebo, both with aspirin 325 mg once daily)
brain_mri_data: Recruitment visit (acquisitions as per local practices)

major_inclusion_criteria: Age ≥70 years, without cardiovascular disease, diabetes or dementia
intervention_and_comparator: Atorvastatin 40 mg per day vs placebo
primary_outcome_follow_up: Co-primary outcomes: disability-free survival (without dementia or persistent physical disability), major cardiovascular events (expected mean follow-up = 6 years)
brain_mri_data: Recruitment and 4-year visits in the STAREE-MIND Imaging study (3T)
genetic_and_brain_mri_data_n: 340 with brain MRI, most with DNA collected (as part of the STAREE biobank)
